g.text: The board only pairs after a double press of its BOOT button (two quick presses), for 60 s.
Looking for the board on this network...
Press the BOOT button on the board now (within 30 s). Its LED blinks fast while it waits.
If the board has a display, it must show this computer's name and the same code: if it shows
another code or another name, do NOT press, someone else is asking.

hing was stored; run tentacle pair again"}
